messages.author: 57c99aae7e401317
messages.subject: Golf example from recent Webinar
parts:
Hello Stan Users,

I am trying to run the golf example and received the following error:

> golf %<>%
+ mutate(
+ p = successes / tries,
+ error_sd = sqrt((p  * (1 - p)) / tries),
+ lower = p - 2 * error_sd,
+ upper = p + 2 * error_sd,
+ fit = 2 * pnorm(theta0(dist) / sigma) - 1
+ )
Error: could not find function "%<>%"

Any suggestions?

Thanks,

James

messages.author: 34bfea33d3d3fbae
messages.subject: Re: Golf example from recent Webinar
parts:
In case you really need %<>% operator, which in this case equals to
golf <- golf %>%
you should add
library(magrittr)
somewhere in your code.

messages.author: 34bfea33d3d3fbae
messages.subject: Re: Golf example from recent Webinar
parts:
Just in case, magrittr has more operators than dplyr, you can read about them in vignette page https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/magrittr/vignettes/magrittr.html For example aforementioned operator is in section "Additional pipe operators". But my favorite is tee operator, that can be used for functions with side-effects, like in the following example
rnorm(1e3) %>%
  as.data.frame %T>%
  { names(.) <- "x" } %>%
  {
    ggplot(., aes(x = x)) + geom_density()
  }
